name: When should I consider using a 1031 Exchange for my multifamily investment?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider using a 1031 Exchange for my multifamily investment?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a 1031 Exchange when you want to upgrade to a larger or higher-income-producing multifamily property, relocate your investment to a more desirable market, or diversify your real estate portfolio without incurring immediate capital gains taxes. It's particularly beneficial when you have significant appreciation in your current property and plan to remain invested in real estate. This strategy is less suitable if you intend to cash out of your investment entirely, as the tax deferral is contingent on reinvestment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a 1031 Exchange when you aim to upgrade, relocate, or diversify your multifamily real estate investments without immediately paying capital gains taxes.
